team_run.headline: Download, do one session, send 3 files — both platforms
team_run.mac_status_meaning: Mac launch fix implemented and build available. A real tester's session launched and produced valid data, but that same run measured ~5.7 fps (well under our 45fps target) — a Mac performance tier has since been added and shipped. Post-fix performance on real Mac hardware has NOT yet been re-verified. This is the one item still awaiting a human test.
team_run.mac_note: Mac build is universal (Apple Silicon + Intel). Unsigned, so the first launch is blocked: double-click once, dismiss the warning, then System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> 'Open Anyway'. (Terminal fallback: xattr -cr on the app.) A Mac performance tier was added after the first test found low fps -- re-tests are exactly what we need to confirm it now holds the target (45fps avg / 30fps min / control-treatment within 10%).
